notes.title: [Update!] Fix for Spirits of Mystery: Amber Maiden Collector's Edition
notes.content:
We've received some reports about missing objects in the Hidden Object scenes, and have uploaded an update to fix this issue. Please restart the Steam client to trigger the automatic update. You should find any missing items right away. 

As always, thank you for your feedback!
